table.name: setting_values
table.purpose: persist only explicit writes for code-defined typed settings; absent settings remain absent
columns: revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: setting_key must exist in the closed SettingDefinitionRegistry before read/write interpretation
contract_name/version must match the registered definition or an explicit registered upgrader path
value_json is parsed/validated through LLD-01 strict JSON contract before persistence
unknown keys/versions are rejected or quarantined by explicit upgrade policy; they are never silently treated as current
reading an absent setting returns the code-defined default from SettingDefinition without inserting a row

ordinary settings storage excludes passwords, verifier material, encryption keys, run-auth tokens, device credentials, unrestricted Communication bodies/provider payloads and complete domain-object copies
every accepted write uses base revision/equivalent precondition and LLD-01 authoritative command + audit boundary

setting_definition.rule: semantic_owner validates business meaning; LLD-02 registry/persistence mechanics do not become the setting's domain authority

upgrade_rule: A registered upgrade parses and validates the old version, produces and validates the new version, then replaces value/contract_version/revision atomically in one UnitOfWork. Failure preserves the prior bytes/value.
